title: Activated Charcoal Deep Cleanse Face Wash
description:
Detoxify and purify your skin with our Activated Charcoal Deep Cleanse Face Wash — a powerful yet gentle cleanser that draws out impurities, excess oil, and environmental toxins from deep within the pores. Enriched with Kaolin Clay and Willow Bark Extract for a thorough, pore-refining cleanse.Key Benefits
Deep-cleanses pores and removes blackheads
Controls excess sebum and shine throughout the day
Detoxifies skin from pollution and environmental stressors
Refines pores for a smoother, matte complexion
Leaves skin feeling fresh, clean, and balanced — not tight or dry
Key Ingredients

Activated Charcoal – Acts like a magnet to draw out dirt, oil, and toxins from pores

Kaolin Clay – Gently absorbs excess oil without over-drying

Willow Bark Extract – Natural source of salicylic acid that exfoliates and unclogs pores

Witch Hazel – Tones and tightens pores while reducing inflammation

Glycerin – Maintains skin hydration balance post-cleanse
How to UseWet face with lukewarm water. Squeeze a small amount onto fingertips and massage gently onto face in circular motions for 60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly. Use morning and evening. Follow with a toner and oil-free moisturiser.150ml | Best for oily, combination & acne-prone skin | Vegan & Cruelty-free

title: Hair Growth & Scalp Revival Serum
description:
Revitalise your scalp and stimulate thicker, fuller hair with our Hair Growth & Scalp Revival Serum — a targeted treatment serum powered by Redensyl, Caffeine, and Peppermint Oil. Clinically formulated to reactivate dormant hair follicles, reduce hair fall, and promote visible new growth in as little as 4 weeks.Key Benefits
Stimulates hair follicles and promotes new hair growth
Significantly reduces hair fall and thinning
Improves scalp circulation and follicle health
Nourishes the scalp to create an optimal growth environment
Lightweight, non-greasy formula — no residue or build-up
Key Ingredients

Redensyl – Clinically proven hair growth active that targets hair follicle stem cells

Caffeine – Stimulates blood circulation in the scalp to energise follicles

Peppermint Oil – Increases scalp blood flow and provides a refreshing, cooling sensation

Biotin (Vitamin B7) – Strengthens hair from root to tip and reduces breakage

Niacinamide – Improves scalp health and reduces inflammation
How to UsePart hair into sections and apply directly to the scalp. Massage gently with fingertips for 2–3 minutes to boost absorption. Do not rinse. Use once daily, preferably at night. For best results, use consistently for a minimum of 8 weeks.50ml | Thinning, fine & hair-loss-prone hair | Suitable for men & women | Paraben-free

title: Hyaluronic Acid Hydration Booster Serum
description:
Quench your skin's thirst with our Hyaluronic Acid Hydration Booster Serum — a multi-molecular weight Hyaluronic Acid serum that delivers intense, long-lasting hydration at every layer of the skin. Infused with Aloe Vera, Panthenol, and Sodium PCA for a plumping, dewy finish that lasts all day.Key Benefits
Provides deep, multi-layer hydration for plump, bouncy skin
Instantly smooths fine lines caused by dehydration
Strengthens the skin barrier and reduces water loss
Suitable for all skin types including oily and acne-prone
Lightweight gel texture that layers perfectly under makeup
Key Ingredients

Multi-Molecular Hyaluronic Acid – Penetrates multiple skin layers to hydrate from within

Aloe Vera – Soothes and provides surface-level moisture

Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5) – Repairs and softens the skin barrier

Sodium PCA – Natural humectant that attracts and retains moisture
How to UseApply 3–5 drops to slightly damp skin morning and evening after cleansing. Press gently into face and neck. Follow immediately with a moisturiser to seal in hydration. Can be layered under other serums.30ml | All skin types especially dry & dehydrated | Oil-free & Non-comedogenic

title: Hydrating Vitamin C Face Wash
description:
Reveal brighter, cleaner skin with our Hydrating Vitamin C Face Wash — a gentle yet effective cleanser formulated with stabilised Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, and Green Tea Extract. Designed for daily use, it removes impurities, excess oil, and makeup residue while leaving skin feeling refreshed, soft, and radiant.Key Benefits
Brightens dull skin and evens out skin tone
Deeply cleanses pores without stripping natural moisture
Boosts hydration with Hyaluronic Acid
Fights free radicals with antioxidant-rich Green Tea Extract
Gentle, non-irritating formula suitable for sensitive skin
Dermatologist-tested, fragrance-free, and non-comedogenic
Key Ingredients

Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) – Brightens skin and reduces dark spots

Hyaluronic Acid – Locks in moisture for plump, hydrated skin

Green Tea Extract – Soothes inflammation and protects against oxidative stress

Niacinamide – Minimises pores and improves skin texture

Aloe Vera – Calms and hydrates the skin barrier
How to UseWet your face with lukewarm water. Apply a small amount to your fingertips and gently massage onto your face in circular motions for 30–60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry. Use morning and evening for best results. Follow with a toner and moisturiser.150ml | Suitable for all skin types | Cruelty-free, Vegan & Dermatologist-tested

title: Nourishing Argan Oil Shampoo
description:
Elevate your hair care routine with our Nourishing Argan Oil Shampoo — a salon-grade formula enriched with pure Moroccan Argan Oil, Keratin, and Vitamin E. Designed to deeply cleanse, hydrate, and restore shine to all hair types, especially dry, damaged, or chemically treated hair.Key Benefits
Deeply moisturises and nourishes dry, brittle hair
Reduces frizz and enhances natural shine
Strengthens hair strands and minimises breakage
Sulfate-free, paraben-free, and colour-safe formula
Suitable for all hair types including curly, wavy, and straight

Argan Oil – Rich in fatty acids and antioxidants to restore moisture and shine

Keratin – Strengthens and smooths the hair cuticle

Vitamin E – Protects hair from environmental damage

Aloe Vera – Soothes the scalp and promotes healthy hair growth
How to UseApply a generous amount to wet hair. Massage gently into scalp and work through to the ends. Leave for 1–2 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Follow with a conditioner for best results. Use 3–4 times per week.250ml | Suitable for all hair types | Cruelty-free & Vegan

title: Retinol Anti-Ageing Night Serum
description:
Turn back the clock with our Retinol Anti-Ageing Night Serum — a clinically advanced formula with 0.3% encapsulated Retinol, Peptides, and Squalane that works overnight to reduce fine lines, wrinkles, and loss of firmness. Wake up to visibly smoother, plumper, and more youthful skin.Key Benefits
Reduces the appearance of fine lines and deep wrinkles
Improves skin firmness, elasticity, and texture
Accelerates cell turnover for fresher, younger-looking skin
Minimises enlarged pores and refines skin surface
Encapsulated Retinol formula minimises irritation
Key Ingredients

0.3% Encapsulated Retinol – Slow-release formula for effective anti-ageing with reduced sensitivity

Peptide Complex – Stimulates collagen synthesis and firms skin

Squalane – Lightweight plant-derived oil that locks in moisture overnight

Bakuchiol – Natural retinol alternative that soothes and complements treatment
How to UseApply 3–4 drops to clean skin every evening. Gently press into face and neck, avoiding the eye area. Follow with a rich night moisturiser. Start with 2–3 nights per week and gradually increase. Always use SPF during the day when using retinol.30ml | Mature, ageing & dull skin | Suitable for ages 25+ | Fragrance-free

title: Soothing Rose & Ceramide Face Wash
description:
Pamper your skin with the gentle luxury of our Soothing Rose & Ceramide Face Wash — a creamy, hydrating cleanser crafted for sensitive and dry skin types. Infused with Rose Water, Ceramides, and Oat Extract, it cleanses without disrupting the skin's natural moisture barrier, leaving skin calm, soft, and nourished.Key Benefits
Gently cleanses without stripping natural oils
Restores and strengthens the skin's moisture barrier
Soothes redness, irritation, and sensitivity
Leaves skin feeling velvety soft and deeply comfortable
Fragrance-free and hypoallergenic — safe for reactive skin
Key Ingredients

Rose Water – Natural anti-inflammatory that soothes and tones sensitive skin

Ceramides (NP, AP, EOP) – Replenish the skin barrier and lock in moisture

Colloidal Oat Extract – Calms irritation and relieves dry, itchy skin

Centella Asiatica (Cica) – Promotes healing and reduces redness

Shea Butter – Rich emollient that softens and protects the skin
How to UseApply a small amount to damp skin and gently massage in upward circular motions. Rinse with cool or lukewarm water and pat dry with a soft towel. Use twice daily — morning and night. Ideal as the first step in your skincare routine.150ml | Sensitive, dry & combination skin | Hypoallergenic, Fragrance-free & Dermatologist-tested

title: Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum
description:
Illuminate your complexion with our Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum — a potent, fast-absorbing formula with 15% stabilised Vitamin C, Niacinamide, and Ferulic Acid. Clinically proven to fade dark spots, even skin tone, and deliver a visible glow in just 2 weeks.Key Benefits

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) – Minimises pores and reduces pigmentation

Ferulic Acid – Stabilises Vitamin C and amplifies its antioxidant effect

How to UseApply 3–4 drops to clean, dry skin every morning. Gently press into face and neck. Follow with moisturiser and SPF. Avoid contact with eyes.30ml | All skin types | Fragrance-free & Dermatologist-tested
